_description: Ablation: strong KL regularisation (beta_kl=1.0). Used to measure the upper bound of KL's effect on capability retention and safety trade-off. Expected result: higher retention score but potentially lower MAPPO learning signal, with ASR possibly less reduced than the full model.
_review3_hypothesis: Strong KL forces the policy to stay close to the SFT distribution, preserving benign capability but potentially limiting the adversarial robustness gains from MAPPO self-play.

capability_retention.note: Threshold kept at 1.0 — strong KL should fully preserve benign capability.

gate_policy: GATE-001 through GATE-009 are ACTIVE and UNCHANGED. The gate cannot be disabled for any ablation.
notes: Compare ASR reduction against the baseline beta_kl=0.1 run. If ASR reduction is smaller here, that confirms MAPPO self-play adds security benefit beyond what the SFT warm-up alone provides.
